title: Feature Plan (Phase 2)
description: Front-matter schema for `.harness/plans/feat-NNN.md` — the per-feature plan the planning subagent produces in Phase 2 after the overall plan (Phase 1) is approved. Carries the task specs that rows in feature_list.json point to via planFile.

featId.description: Feature identifier the plan belongs to

overallPlan.description: Relative path to the Phase 1 overall plan this sub-plan derives from (canonical value: `.harness/plans/overview.md`)

status.description: Draft until the breakdown is approved; approved once the breakdown is approved and rows are written.

commitType.description: Conventional Commits type proposed for the feature's commit subject. Editable at commit approval.
